title: Properties of Materials
ques: If you are making an umbrella, why would you choose plastic or nylon material instead of cotton or paper?

answer.content: You would choose plastic or nylon because they are **waterproof** (water cannot pass through them). Cotton and paper absorb water, so an umbrella made of them would leave you soaking wet.

explanation: This tests the practical selection of materials based on their specific physical properties.

title: Natural vs Synthetic
ques: Sort these four materials into 'Natural' and 'Synthetic' (man-made) categories: **Wood, Plastic, Wool, Nylon**.

answer.content:
*   **Natural Materials:** Wood (from trees) and Wool (from sheep).
*   **Synthetic Materials:** Plastic (made from oil) and Nylon (made in chemical factories).

explanation: This classifies materials based on their origin.

title: Transparency
ques: Explain the difference between a **transparent** material and a **translucent** material. Give one example of each.

answer.content: A **transparent** material (like clear glass) lets all light pass through, so you can see clearly through it. A **translucent** material (like frosted glass or butter paper) lets only some light pass through, so objects on the other side look blurry.

explanation: This defines optical properties of materials with high precision.
